_comment: Sample settings.json for public consumers of dotty's plugin-install harness — this is the estate's own full session shape (env, permissions, statusline), not dotty's own project-scope declaration (that's the real, committed .claude/settings.json alongside this file, which only declares the plugins a session opened in dotty needs). Copy the blocks you want into your own settings.json. Hooks and the statusline are NOT registered by path here — they ship inside the enabled plugins (installed and enabled separately, e.g. via `claude plugin marketplace add` / `install` / `enable`) and the harness installs the statusline to a fixed path. TODO: set VAULT_ROOT to your Obsidian vault (the vault-aware hooks fail-open and silently disable themselves without it), and swap core/estate-hooks/publish for your own marketplace and plugin names if you're not using this estate's.
